Sam (Events): Heads up — captions started repeating around 00:18 in the stream and the slide timestamps are out by ~30s. Remote presenter (Marco) also dropped audio for about 40s. Can someone triage? 🙏
Leah: saw it, trying to switch to backup captions. @OBS-bot can you confirm captions feed switchover?
OBS-bot: switching to `captions-feed-2` now. Recording continues.
Marco: hey sorry — my mic muted on my end when I was switching rooms. Live mic is unmuted now. Can we get the segment clip at 00:17–00:20? need for docs.
Jesse: @Sam grabbing clip now. Which recorder holds live archive? `local-recorder-1` or `gcs-archive`?
Sam (Events): `gcs-archive` is primary, `local-recorder-1` has iso. Prefer gcs clip and iso as backup.
Jesse: pulling 00:17–00:21 from gcs, will upload to #clips in ~5m. Also uploading iso to `/shared/allhands/b-roll`.
Leah: captions fixed and resynced. Did a small burn-in patch, might need to re-run transcript alignment for VOD.
Sam (Events): thanks. Post-mortem note: add a preflight step to verify captions burn-in + presenter mic test 5 mins before. Can someone add to Runbook? @Marco can you paste the exact time you lost audio?
Marco: dropped at 00:17:12, back at 00:17:52. Posted notes in the event doc.
OBS-bot: clip upload complete: https://gcs.example/replay/3951234567_clip_17-21.mp4 :thumbsup:
Jesse: uploaded iso to /shared/allhands/b-roll/3951234567_iso_17-21.mp4
Sam (Events): perfect. I'll update the runbook and add the preflight checklist item. Thanks y'all :partyparrot:
